name: Shaftesbury Capital PLC
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 from Shaftesbury Capital PLC interim results consolidated income statement unaudited, six months ended 30 June 2026, unit GBP million stored in absolute pounds. Revenue 122.7 less printed costs 30.6 equals the printed gross profit 92.1. Operating Expenses 24.6 is the printed administration expenses. Operating profit 249.8 is printed and includes the 181.4 gain on revaluation and sale of investment property and a 1.1 change in value of investments, so gross profit less operating expenses sits below EBIT. Net Finance Costs 18.7 is the printed net finance costs line. EBIT less Net Finance Costs less the separately printed 3.0 loss on sale of an investment in a joint venture equals the printed profit before tax 228.1. Taxation was nil so profit for the period is 228.1, of which 193.8 is attributable to owners of the Parent and 34.3 to non-controlling interests. Basic EPS 10.6 pence.
